nodes.label: DB::Put / DB::Write
nodes.desc: Public write API; callers assemble a WriteBatch of mutations and commit it atomically.

nodes.label: DB::Get / DBImpl::GetImpl
nodes.desc: Point lookup implementation (sync and coroutine async variants generated from one source).

nodes.label: DB::NewIterator (DBIter)
nodes.desc: Merging iterator that hides deletions, snapshots, and duplicate versions from the user.

nodes.label: DBImpl::CompactRange
nodes.desc: Manual compaction API: walks the requested key range level by level.

nodes.label: ColumnFamilyOptions / DBOptions
nodes.desc: Per-column-family and per-DB tuning: memtable factory, compaction style, WAL policy, compression.

nodes.label: DBImpl::Write
nodes.desc: Entry into the write queue; serializes writers and forwards to WriteImpl.

nodes.label: WriteThread::EnterAsMemTableWriter
nodes.desc: Leader/follower write batching: one leader writes the WAL and installs memtable entries for the group.

nodes.label: DBImpl::WriteToWAL
nodes.desc: Merges the leader's group into one batch and writes it to the WAL.

nodes.label: Writer::AddRecord (WAL)
nodes.desc: Emits CRC32C-checksummed, length-prefixed log records to the write-ahead log.

nodes.label: WriteBatchInternal::InsertInto
nodes.desc: Iterates the serialized batch, dispatching each record to a handler.

nodes.label: MemTableInserter
nodes.desc: WriteBatch handler that translates Put/Delete/Merge records into memtable calls.

nodes.label: MemTable::Add
nodes.desc: Encodes sequence number, type, key, and value into an arena-allocated entry.

nodes.label: SkipListRep::Insert
nodes.desc: Default memtable representation: an InlineSkipList ordered by the internal key comparator.

nodes.label: InlineSkipList::Insert
nodes.desc: Lock-free probabilistic skip list supporting concurrent insertion and lock-free reads.

nodes.label: MemTableListVersion::Get
nodes.desc: Looks a key up across the immutable (still-flushing) memtables, newest first.

nodes.label: MemTableList::PickMemtablesToFlush
nodes.desc: Selects the oldest immutable memtables that are ready to become L0 files.

nodes.label: DBImpl::BackgroundCallFlush
nodes.desc: Flush thread loop: picks a column family, runs a flush, installs results, signals compaction.

nodes.label: DBImpl::FlushMemTableToOutputFile
nodes.desc: Orchestrates one flush: makes a memtable immutable, builds the FlushJob, publishes the result.

nodes.label: FlushJob::Run
nodes.desc: Streams the picked memtable entries into an L0 SST via BuildTable.

nodes.label: BuildTable
nodes.desc: Shared helper that turns an iterator stream into one sorted SST file, then reports its metadata.

nodes.label: BlockBasedTableBuilder::Add
nodes.desc: Buffers key/value pairs into compressed data blocks and maintains per-block indexes.

nodes.label: BlockBasedTableBuilder::Finish
nodes.desc: Flushes index, filter, range-tombstone, properties, and footer blocks to complete the SST.

nodes.label: FullFilterBlockBuilder::Add
nodes.desc: Builds the whole-file bloom/Ribbon filter that lets point lookups skip non-matching SSTs.

nodes.label: BlockBasedTable::Open
nodes.desc: Reads footer, index, and filter blocks to open an SST for reading.

nodes.label: BlockBasedTable::Get
nodes.desc: Per-SST point lookup: consults the filter, binary-searches the index, then fetches one data block.

nodes.label: DBImpl::BackgroundCallCompaction
nodes.desc: Compaction thread loop: installs finished results, picks the next compaction, repeats.

nodes.label: LevelCompactionPicker::PickCompaction
nodes.desc: Chooses a level and overlapping inputs for leveled compaction.

nodes.label: CompactionJob::Run
nodes.desc: Drives the merge: sub-compactions, output SST creation, and result installation.

nodes.label: CompactionIterator::NextFromInput
nodes.desc: Core merge logic: deduplicates keys, applies snapshots, drops tombstones and expired data.

nodes.label: MergeHelper::MergeUntil
nodes.desc: Folds merge operands into one value using the user's MergeOperator.

nodes.label: VersionSet::LogAndApply
nodes.desc: Serializes all metadata updates: appends the VersionEdit to the MANIFEST and swaps in the new Version.

nodes.label: Version::Get
nodes.desc: Immutable LSM snapshot search: probes each level's files newest-first for the lookup key.

nodes.label: ColumnFamilyData
nodes.desc: Per-column-family state: current Version, memtable lists, and SuperVersion swapping.

nodes.label: TableCache::Get
nodes.desc: Caches open table readers and forwards lookups into BlockBasedTable::Get.
